name.description:
Name for vertex that is locally unique to the graph. Used for visualization, as well as user access. This should
NOT be a UUID.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

x.description: Names of ports corresponding to x input.

y.description: Names of ports corresponding to y input.

context.description: Names of ports corresponding to context input.

processOnly.description:
If true, then the pipe should only be used to process, instead of the default train-then-process.
Only one of this, {@link #trainOnly}, {@link #scoreOnly}, and {@link #interpretOnly} should be set at a time.

trainOnly.description:
If true, then the pipe should only be used to train, instead of the default train-then-process.
Only one of this, @link #processOnly}, {@link #scoreOnly}, and {@link #interpretOnly} should be set at a time.

scoreOnly.description:
If true, then the pipe should only be used to score. Only one of this, {@link #processOnly}, and {@link #trainOnly},
 and {@link #interpretOnly} should be set at a time.

interpretOnly.description:
If true, then the pipe should only be used to interpret. Only one of this, {@link #processOnly}, {@link #trainOnly},
and {@link #scoreOnly} should be set at a time.

convertSpec.description: {@link MlConvertSpec} used by shared {@link #pipe} in {@link #processOnly} vertices

isXNestedInput.description: Whether the vertex has nested-input ports for x.

isYNestedInput.description: Whether the vertex has nested-input ports for y.

isNestedOutput.description: Whether the vertex has nested-output ports.

title: A specialized {@link FlowGraph.Vertex} that represents a pipe vertex in an {@link MlPipeline}.
name: MlPipeline.PipeVertex
